FAQ

Questions about Calquors Private Limited

What is Calquors?

Calquors is a product studio based in India. We design, build and run mobile apps and web platforms — our own products, such as OmegleVC and Klyq, and products for clients.

Is Calquors Private Limited the same as Calquors Pvt Ltd?

Yes. "Pvt Ltd" is the standard short form of "Private Limited". Calquors Private Limited, Calquors Pvt Ltd and Calquors all refer to the same company.

Where is Calquors Private Limited based?

Calquors Private Limited is an Indian company. We work with clients across India and worldwide.

Which apps has Calquors Private Limited published?

OmegleVC (web and Android) and Klyq (Android) are published on Google Play under the developer name CALQUORS PRIVATE LIMITED. We also built Revfit for iOS and run Rivelo Labs, our engineering arm.

Does Calquors take on client projects?

Yes. We take on mobile app, web platform, backend engineering and product design work, from first prototype to launch on the App Store and Google Play.

How do I contact Calquors?

Email support@calquors.com or use the contact form on calquors.com/contact. We reply within one business day.
